cards.stem: Which method did Clair Cameron Patterson use in 1956 to date the Canyon Diablo meteorite?
cards.quote: It was 1956 when Clair Cameron Patterson, an American geochemist, used lead-lead dating
cards.hint: Recall the dating method tied to Patterson in 1956

cards.stem: What is the current scientific age of Earth described as hard to grasp?
cards.quote: Earth is 4.54 billion years old, a span of time that is hard for many people to grasp.
cards.hint: Think of the modern deep time age

cards.stem: What principle from 1815 states that species become extinct and are replaced by new species?
cards.quote: In 1815, Smith developed the law of faunal succession, which states that species become extinct and are replaced by new species
cards.hint: Surveyor Smith noted fossil order across England

cards.stem: What describes the time for half of parent isotopes to decay to a daughter product?
cards.quote: A half-life is the length of time it takes for half of the number of original, or parent, isotopes to decay to a stable daughter isotope.
cards.hint: Focus on the definition of half-life
